title: dashboards: a sankey widget with two dimensions silently draws only the first category's flows
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect (silent data loss in a chart) found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase. In a writable package, define a dataset over an object with two categorical fields (e.g. `status` and `category`, several values each) and a count measure.
2. Author a dashboard widget `{"type":"sankey","dataset":"DATASET","dimensions":["status","category"],"values":["task_count"]}` and a pivot over the same dataset for comparison. Publish and open the dashboard.
3. Expected: a sankey whose flows cover every first-dimension value (or a stated refusal of a two-dimension sankey).
4. Actual: a single root node (the first category value, e.g. "Alpha") whose flows (3/2/2) are that value's subset only. The pivot shows Alpha/Beta/Gamma. Nothing says data was dropped.

## Mechanism
The sankey arm of `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` uses `series[0]` only. A two-dimension query yields one series per first-dimension value, and all but the first are discarded.
